lead.headline: Claims lock at 01:00: Hockenson and Bass, or two zeros
lead.deck: 2-5. The last brief before the window closes — claim tonight, then Allen and Tuten in before Thursday.
lead.body: Start with the bad news: nothing has moved since this morning. AVIATO are 2-5, Love is still at quarterback, and Likely (Giants) and Fairbairn (Texans) are on bye with no cover. Waiver claims process at 01:00 tonight; the Wednesday brief is too late. Claim T.J. Hockenson, back from his concussion and Kyler Murray's tight end, with Hunter Henry as the second claim on the same drop (Love), and Tyler Bass for Fairbairn — Buffalo host Baltimore in the week's highest total, with Lamar Jackson now expected to play. Then, before Thursday 18:15, Allen into the QB slot and Tuten into the RB slot. One worry from this morning eased: Jalen Coker practised fully on Tuesday.
